documents.title: Coolant flow and chamber temperature
documents.text: Process SYN-PROC-ETCH-01 on tool SYN-TOOL-01. Abnormal chamber temperature with stable pressure indicates cooling_flow_low. Check coolant valve SYN-VALVE-C1 on chamber SYN-CHAMBER-A. Sensor SYN-SENSOR-TEMP reports the chamber temperature.

documents.title: Vacuum pressure drop
documents.text: Process SYN-PROC-ETCH-02. A vacuum pressure drop with temperature near target indicates pressure_leak. Inspect the chamber seal and sensor SYN-SENSOR-PRESSURE.

documents.title: Readings within target
documents.text: Process SYN-PROC-ETCH-03 is within target. Stable readings and normal coolant flow do not indicate a fault.

documents.title: Other tenant cooling note
documents.text: Process SYN-PROC-OTHER uses SYN-TOOL-99. A separate sentence mentions SYN-PROC-ETCH-01 abnormal chamber temperature so a missing tenant filter would leak it.
